asean::Myanmar.evidence: ASEAN's 2025 leaders review reaffirmed the Five-Point Consensus and recorded the need for full implementation in Myanmar.

asean::Timor-Leste.evidence: Timor-Leste acceded to the ASEAN Charter in October 2025 and continued depositing instruments required by the membership roadmap.

mercosur::Bolivia.evidence: Bolivia deposited its ratification instrument in July 2024 and has up to four years to incorporate the bloc's normative acquis.

mercosur::Venezuela.evidence: MERCOSUR states that Venezuela is suspended from all rights and obligations inherent to State Party status.

oas::Nicaragua.evidence: The OAS depositary records that Nicaragua ceased to be a State Party to the OAS Charter on 19 November 2023; other inter-American obligations can continue.

oas::Cuba.evidence: The 2009 General Assembly resolution ended the 1962 exclusion but made participation subject to a dialogue initiated at Cuba's request; the dossier does not treat Cuba as an active participant.

eu::Denmark.evidence: Denmark has a treaty opt-out from adopting the euro; this is a formal differentiation, not non-membership.

eu::Ireland.evidence: Ireland has negotiated opt-outs in Schengen and parts of the area of freedom, security and justice.

au::Sudan.evidence: The African Union records Sudan's suspension from participation pending a civilian-led transitional authority.

au::Mali.evidence: The African Union Peace and Security Council suspended Mali from participation until normal constitutional order is restored.

au::Burkina Faso.evidence: African Union records identify Burkina Faso among states subject to political sanctions following unconstitutional changes of government; current participation must be reverified against the latest PSC decision.

au::Niger.evidence: African Union records identify Niger among states subject to political sanctions following unconstitutional changes of government; current participation must be reverified against the latest PSC decision.

au::Guinea.evidence: The AU Commission reported Guinea's return to constitutional order and return to the Union following its transition.

au::Gabon.evidence: The AU Peace and Security Council lifted Gabon's suspension on 30 April 2025 following its return to constitutional order.

oic::Syria.evidence: Syria remains listed in the organisation's state register while participation is treated as suspended in the embedded institutional dossier.

g20::European Union.evidence: The European Union participates as a permanent institutional member rather than as a country.

g20::African Union.evidence: The African Union has participated as a permanent G20 member since its admission in 2023.
